t: Fixed: play-by-play scores. ESPN's running score is often a play early or late, or keeps a basket that was taken off (about a third of games). The score beside each play is now added up from the scoring plays, which always match the official score, and the score at the top uses the freshest figures. Scoring plays no longer look like boxed cards, and a match page that ESPN briefly stops sending now keeps trying (every 20 seconds during a game) instead of giving up.
The Leaderboard is now live: it updates the moment anyone places, settles or cashes out a bet, using the same checks against official results. The server still re-checks every bet every 30 minutes.
Leaderboard: the Void column is now Cash outs, so you can see how often each player cashed out.

New look: match pages and profiles carry each team's own colours, game cards on bigger screens show Head to head, Line and Total side by side, numbers line up in every table, and pages show the shape of what's loading instead of a spinner.

New: soccer players get Shot map, Trends and Splits tabs, and clubs get an Analytics tab: record, clean sheets, when goals come, half-time results, team vs opponents, shots taken and faced, top scorers and head to head, for the Premier League and Champions League. Graphs now draw straight lines between real results, prices are never cut off on phones, and charts answer a tap.

New: NBA shot charts from ESPN's real shot locations, with zones compared to the league and heat maps, plus Trends and Splits tabs on every player. Teams get an Analytics tab (ratings, quarter scoring, shooting, head to head). Match pages add a shot chart and game flow, and soccer matches show every event and a shot map. Game logs now cover the whole season, not just the last 10 games.

Fixed: the page no longer jumps back to the top or the first tab when you tap something. Market tabs like Triple Double stay where you scrolled, open sections stay open through live updates, and Back returns you to the same spot.
Every player is now on the Leaderboard automatically, ranked on their checked results. You can hide your bet history in your profile.

New: Leaderboard. Join from the Leaderboard tab to rank your real results by profit, ROI, win rate or wins, filtered by period, sport and bet type. Every bet is checked against official results, and you can hide your bet history or leave at any time.
Cash outs are lower on multis: every leg still to play now carries its own margin, like a bookmaker's live odds, so the more legs left, the smaller the offer. Legs already won count in full.
Fixed: when a player doesn't play, that leg is voided and your multi's odds and return are recalculated from the remaining legs straight away (original odds shown for reference).
Fairer cash outs: the value is now the bet's fair worth less a stated 5% (8% live) margin, shown next to what you'd win by keeping it open and your chance of winning.
New: log in with your username and password on any phone or computer. Already playing? Choose Create account with your same username to move your bets online.
New look: team records on game cards, league logos on the tabs, win chances in team colours, a status strip on every bet and a frosted header.
More accurate odds: alternate lines are now tuned to 2,300+ real bookmaker prices, so estimated lines sit within about 10% of the real market.
Cleaner look and calmer motion: softer page fades, live scores glow when they change, new slip picks slide in, and less clutter on Home.
Fixed: when a multi loses early, its other legs now show HIT or MISS once their games finish (they stayed PENDING). Smoother graphs and page transitions.
Fixed: prices now follow PointsBet. Lines PointsBet lists use its exact price, and other alternate lines are priced from PointsBet's own line, so no more silly odds like 8+ assists at $9.
Fixed: cashed-out multis now show each leg's final stat with HIT or MISS (they stayed PENDING before). The cash-out amount is unchanged.
Fixed: your bet slip is now saved when you leave, finished games never show LIVE (legs show the final figure with HIT or MISS), and older open bets settle on the real final.
Fixed: cash-outs now have their own count in your profile record instead of being counted as void.
Fixed: finished games no longer stay on Home (they move to Past games), cash out now works during live games, and Miss-1 bets keep cash out after one missed leg.
New: live scoreboards with quarter or half scores, a live box score on every game page (updates every 30 seconds), and player photos with recent form beside every player bet.
Fixed: soccer players now show their photo where a verified one exists (about 1,070 players), otherwise their club crest.
New: official team logos everywhere, and fuller player profiles (shooting %, hit rates for every line, upcoming games, game logs that open each match).
Fixed: Feedback is now on phones (top of the screen), and you get a message when a new version with fixes is ready.
New: tap any past game for its full match centre: box score, team stats, play-by-play or timeline, lineups and how your bets did.
Bolder green and red for wins, hits and profit vs losses and misses. Pending and void are now neutral grey.
New look: game-by-game player and team graphs with hit/miss colours, line labels, filters and tap-for-details.
Past games now sits next to Home on every screen size.
Fixed: bets on finished games could stay pending. They now settle as soon as ESPN confirms the final score.
Fixed: some multis were wrongly voided and refunded. They have been re-settled on the real result.
New: Past games, every game from the last 24 hours with scores, stats and your bets.
